DLC2310:4:t_010:10.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「What...? Their coordination has visibly improved!」

DLC2310:4:t_010:11.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「We're fighting for the same goal now!」

DLC2310:4:t_010:12.en:
$$シン$$
「To stop people like you from starting wars!」

DLC2310:4:t_010:13.en:
$$キラ$$
「That's why we can... become one!」

DLC2310:4:t_010:14.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$ハマーン$$! If you're going to change things through war, we'll take you on right here!」

DLC2310:4:t_011:1.en:
$$ハマーン$$
（$$ネオ・ジオン$$ is still lacking in every respect if we are to fight opponents like these...）

DLC2310:4:t_011:2.en:
$$ハマーン$$
（If he will not return to $$ジオン$$, then I have no choice but to make use of a creature like that...）

DLC2310:4:t_012:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Don't chase her too far, $$シン$$. For now, it's enough to report $$ネオ・ジオン$$'s existence to the main force.」

DLC2310:4:t_013:0.en:
$$シン$$
「You're the last person I want to hear that from, $$キラ$$.」

DLC2310:4:t_013:1.en:
$$シン$$
「I know you saved me, but if anything had gone wrong back there, you could have died.」

DLC2310:4:t_013:2.en:
$$キラ$$
「I'm sorry. I'll be more careful from now on.」

DLC2310:4:t_013:3.en:
$$シン$$
「You don't have to apologize. It was my fault for nearly getting taken out by $$ハマーン$$ in the first place.」

DLC2310:4:t_013:4.en:
$$キラ$$
「But I'm sure you could have dodged an attack like that, $$シン$$.」

DLC2310:4:t_013:6.en:
$$シン$$
「Wait! Then there was even less reason for you to take that risk!」

DLC2310:4:t_013:7.en:
$$キラ$$
「I'm sorry. But my body just moved on its own.」

DLC2310:4:t_013:8.en:
$$シン$$
「I'm telling you! You don't have to keep apologizing!」

DLC2310:4:t_013:9.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Shall we continue this when we get back? Captain $$ブライト$$ and the others must be waiting for our report.」

DLC2310:4:t_013:10.en:
$$シン$$
「$$キラ$$, you're having dinner with me when we get back. We're going to talk this through properly.」

DLC2310:4:t_013:11.en:
$$キラ$$
「I think... I'm in the mood for Japanese food.」

DLC2310:4:t_013:12.en:
$$シン$$
「I don't care what we eat!」

DLC2310:4:t_013:13.en:
$$キラ$$
「Let's invite $$アスラン$$ and the others, too.」

DLC2310:4:t_013:14.en:
$$シン$$
「I don't care how many people come!」

DLC2310:4:t_013:15.en:
$$カミーユ$$
（Looks like I don't need to worry about them anymore...）

DLC2310:4:t_100:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
（So what Captain $$ブライト$$ and the others feared has happened...!）

DLC2310:4:t_100:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
（The $$多元戦争$$ is over, and peace still won't come to the world...!）

DLC2310:4:t_101:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
（$$シン$$ and $$キラ$$... It looks like they've finally put their past behind them.）

DLC2310:4:t_101:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
（I can't let them outdo me...! I'll do everything I can to stop the fighting!）

DLC2310:4:t_102:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$ハマーン・カーン$$! Can't you think of any way other than fighting?!」

DLC2310:4:t_102:1.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Changing the situation requires drastic measures! Tell that man as much!」

DLC2310:4:t_102:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「You mean Captain $$クワトロ$$!」

DLC2310:4:t_102:3.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「That man can change the world! Let him know there are people who believe in him!」

DLC2310:4:t_102:4.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「The captain would never accept that reasoning! I'll stop you right here!」

DLC2310:4:t_103:0.en:
$$シン$$
「You haven't even tried anything besides fighting...! Do you want a war that badly?!」

DLC2310:4:t_103:1.en:
$$シン$$
「Then I'll take you on! Come at me, all of you!」

DLC2310:4:t_104:0.en:
$$シン$$
（$$キラ$$ felt the same way I did... I knew it already, but today, I think I finally felt it in my heart.）

DLC2310:4:t_104:1.en:
$$シン$$
（There'll probably be more fighting... But as long as I have comrades who feel the same way, I can keep going...!）

DLC2310:4:t_105:0.en:
$$キラ$$
（There's going to be more fighting...）

DLC2310:4:t_105:1.en:
$$キラ$$
（And when it comes... what will I be able to do...?）

DLC2310:4:t_106:0.en:
$$キラ$$
（I still don't know what I can do...）

DLC2310:4:t_106:1.en:
$$キラ$$
（But I'll keep fighting. Together with comrades who share my hopes...!）

DLC2310:4:t_107:0.en:
$$ハマーン$$
（$$シン・アスカ$$, the one $$デュランダル$$ favored; $$キラ・ヤマト$$, the $$スーパーコーディネイター$$; and $$カミーユ・ビダン$$, in whom $$シャア$$ placed his hopes...）

DLC2310:4:t_107:1.en:
$$ハマーン$$
（If I cannot defeat them, I cannot lead $$ネオ・ジオン$$...! I will do it!）

review.context: The three pilots drive Haman off; Shinn and Kira talk openly and arrange dinner. Their combat lines establish that all three want to end future wars.
decisions: Haman's reference to that man in the combat exchange is explicitly settled as Quattro by Kamille's reply.
The unspecified creature Haman must use remains unspecified, matching her internal monologue.
